obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived target; finite correspondence is not proof
obernants.domain: Stated sieve/modular API or finite test domain
obernants.operator: Universe (u64 n,u64 m) x Result<u64,error>. m=0 excludes every output except ZeroModulus; m>0 excludes errors and values unequal to recurrence residue. m=1 excludes every result except Ok(0). This target does not turn finite evidence into proof.

obernants.operator: For fixed m,r retain all n with F(n)=r mod m. Fibers generally contain many indices; m=1 retains every u64 index. Without fixed modulus retain the union over nonzero moduli. ZeroModulus forgets n entirely.

obernants.operator: After prefix k, (a,b)=(F(k),F(k+1)) mod m. Swapping even assignment compiles and fails exhaustive_iterative_oracle.
